_comment: v18 campaign grid — fixes custom_stoploss bug (v17 no-op), sweeps K_MULT+label_period alignment, ML_THRESHOLD. 12 combos × 2 windows = 24 runs.

_grid_rationale.k_mult: Aligns barrier multiplier with stoploss scale. k_mult=1.0 → 1×ATR barriers + 1×ATR SL (tight R:R, more resolved labels). k_mult=1.5 → moderate. k_mult=2.0 → v17 default (60%+ NaN — too few resolved labels in 6h window).
_grid_rationale.label_period_candles: 12h (2× label) gives more resolution time vs 24h. Both sweep with k_mult to see which combo resolves enough labels while keeping R:R valid.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: 0.60 = R8 winner. 0.65 = higher precision, fewer but higher-quality signals. Tests whether stricter filter improves PF.

_bugs_fixed_v18.A: custom_stoploss trail activated at profit > 1×ATR but locked at 2×ATR — stoploss_from_open returned POSITIVE (stop above current price) → FreqTrade fell back to hard -8% stop. Every winner capped at hard stoploss distance.
_bugs_fixed_v18.B: custom_stoploss return checks used `> 0` (valid stop = negative) → EVERY valid stop was discarded. Both initial and trail stops were dead. Only hard -8% config stoploss fired.
_bugs_fixed_v18.C: backtest_config.json had include_timeframes: ['15m'] instead of ['1h'] — mismatched live config, different feature set trained.
_bugs_fixed_v18.D: backtest_config.json had BNB/USDT:USDT (blacklisted) and train_period_days=60 (vs live 90).
